name: RGIS Vision
summary: AI optical character recognition added to RGIS inventory scanners, so counters read alphanumeric part numbers straight off parts and bin labels instead of writing them down. RGIS says a major carrier reported 98.9% inventory accuracy across four warehouses, and the count found more than 2,000 parts not recorded in the airline's system (Aviation Week, January 12, 2026).

whyItMatters: Aviation stores often have missing or no barcodes, and every hand-keyed part number is a chance for error. Better counts mean fewer phantom stock records and fewer emergency buys of parts you already own.
